_comment: Limits for tools/harness/harness.py (compare()): 'max' = higher is worse, 'min' = lower is worse; 'ref' = measured on the board. Set from espforge v0.1.0-rc.0 on the Waveshare AMOLED 1.75, October 4 2026 (4 full runs). Page swipes are plain LVGL scrolling, ~24 fps full-screen redraws: weather_amoled reached ~60 fps by drawing moves as pictures outside LVGL (docs/LESSONS.md, LVGL). After a deliberate change: --update-baseline, review, copy.

easy_connect_qr_s.note: with the channel scan (restored in rc.5; skipping it gave ~0.15 s and was cleared of blame, L172) plus the setup AP held on the channel (L174); the placeholder covers the wait

psram_min_kb.note: slide.c keeps 4 full-screen pictures (shadow, other, 2 neighbours: 1.7 MB)

snapshot_ms.hello.note: the first snapshot after a restart: TLS handshake included (3.1-3.4 s seen, Oct 4)

snapshot_ms.setup1.note: added with the setup1 screen; ref from the next measured run

swipe_gap_max_ms.drag_slow.note: after the drag: LVGL repaints the page it landed on (same picture, 40-50 ms); during it 16 ms (slide: drag lines)

swipe_gap_max_ms.hello_to_system.note: after the drag: LVGL repaints the page it landed on (same picture, 40-50 ms); during it 16 ms (slide: drag lines)

swipe_gap_max_ms.system_to_hello.note: after the drag: LVGL repaints the page it landed on (same picture, 40-50 ms); during it 16 ms (slide: drag lines)
